preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract
Contract must hold at least one NFT token (any ERC721) that the attacker wants to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawNft() function with parameters: token_ = address of the ERC721 NFT contract, destination_ = attacker's address, tokenId_ = ID of the NFT to steal. This will transfer the NFT from the contract to the attacker's address using the IERC721.transferFrom() function. The function only checks that destination is not zero address and that caller is owner.
